newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Macmin says has strong drill results.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Macmin says has strong drill results.

text.p: Mineral explorer Macmin NL said on Friday it received strong drilling results from its Twin Hills silver prospect in Queensland and its Weioko gold prospect in Papua New Guinea.

Macmin said a follow up 11-hole reverse circulation drilling program at Twin Hills had returned significant intersections in all holes with best results including 14 metres at 292 grams per tonne (g/t) silver and 0.19 g/t gold and 38 metres at 85.1 g/t silver and 1.29 g/t gold.
The overall mineralised xone at a 50 g/t silver cut-off was consistently 20 to 30 metres true width with multiple ore grade zones present locally, the company said.
In a statement, managing director Bob McNeill said the results were promising with most of the mineralised sone still to be tested.
"Most of the prospective anomalous zone remains to be drill tested-which gives us great encouragement about the future potential of this discovery," McNeill said.

Macmin said follow-up drilling at the Weioko gold prospect in Papua New Guinea had also returned strong results with best results being 72 metres at 0.96 g/t gold, including 14 metres at 1.82 g/t gold and seven g/t silver; 75 metres at 0.63 g/t gold including eight metres at two g/t gold and five g/t silver ; and 20 metres at 1.16 g/t gold including 6 metres at 2.28 g/t gold.
McNeill said the results built on earlier drilling results that were characterised by very wide intervals of low grade gold, with potential to find further mineralisation.

"The potential for discovering nearby additional bodies of gold mineralisation is good, as the Weioko prospect occurs within extensive gold and arsenic soil anomalism extending over a strike length of 10 kilometres and a width of 1.5 kilometres," McNneill said.
By 2.10 p.m. (0310 GMT), Macmin shares were 1.5 cents higher at 18 cents on turnover of 240,000 shares.
